sampler_basis: stack sampler (scripts/coldstart-probe stacks), 2 cold runs of the unchanged store SDK, 2242 running-process samples, inclusive shares

items.why_it_ran: every definition published by Env/mark_emitted computed its execution receipt (ANF walk) although only publication inspection reads it
items.change: emitted_definition stores {:deferred true :namespace :name}; emitted_definition_data, the one decoder of the row, derives the receipt through the same Emit/execution_entries from the same entries and body hashes

measured.method: test/bl/perf/emitted_definition_cost_test.bl in scripts/check-runtime-hosts on the store SDK image: best-of-5 full republication of bl.cli, build, vm.native, bl.util (157 definitions)
measured.cold_start_estimate_s: 0.25-0.5 (1,438 definitions are published in a cold start); not measured on a built SDK

measured.experiment: -s module before start_cli batch-loading 369 recorded modules with code:ensure_modules_loaded

items.finding: module loading is about 4% of a cold start and a batch does not shorten it; the 21% is mostly processes parked in receive that process_info reports as running

nothing compiles on an unchanged SDK; it stages Sources (callable-ready, retention). Only 7 native host stubs are compiled (14 compile_descriptor calls, about 0.5%), and their bytes embed the .so path
782 ms in the checker is an artifact (edited hosts change the compiler key, so primed native-declarations miss); 1.2% of samples on the real SDK
a safe memo needs a stat of every earlier search dir; at most about 1%
needs a producer-written sealed table and an immutable-root-only reader; the checker image is not under /nix/store, so it cannot be measured there

noise: cold-namespace timings in the checker varied 376-866 ms with load 4-13 and could not separate the change; the isolated republication benchmark above could
